7.10.2 Clear DTCs
For definition of locking the clearing process, refer to chapter 7.7.2.2.
[SWS_Dem_00878] ⌈The Dem module shall provide the Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC
to the J1939Dcm [7] for deleting all active or previously active DTCs from the event
memory. This shall trigger also initializing of related SW-Cs / BSW modules according
to [SWS_Dem_00003].⌋
When one of the diagnostic messages DM03 and DM11 of SAE J1939-73 [14] are
requested, all active (DM11) or previously active (DM03) DTCs have to be cleared,
along with additional information like freeze frames.
[SWS_Dem_00879]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04117
⌈The function Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC shall clear the status of all event(s) related
to the specified DTC(s), as well as all associated event memory entries for these
event(s).⌋
Note: Exceptions may apply due to [SWS_Dem_00515].
